summary: RETEST of iteration-5 blocker (adventureNote overlay) + full 7-phase walkthrough for parables-1, tora-1-1, letters-1, prophets-1 — ALL PASSED. On viewport 390x844: adventureNote now renders with pointerEvents=none (confirmed via computed style), the first/next-available station node (station-node-parables-1 at y≈718, note at y≈780 pe=none) is tappable, station-sheet opens, and station-start-button navigates to station-screen. The i5 blocker is fully resolved.
